import ctypes
import os

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the function prototype
# double gsl_cdf_gaussian_P(const double x, const double sigma);
gsl.gsl_cdf_gaussian_P.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_cdf_gaussian_P.restype = ctypes.c_double

def compute_gaussian_cdf(x, sigma):
    """Compute the CDF of a Gaussian distribution using GSL."""
    if sigma <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Standard deviation sigma must be positive.")
    return gsl.gsl_cdf_gaussian_P(x, sigma)
